name: Which AI Made This?
summary: Gallery comparing AI-generated landing pages from the same prompt across models, with and without a frontend design skill.
description: Renders one landing-page prompt (a note-taking second-brain app) across twelve AI models in five iterations each, grouped by with or without Anthropic's frontend design skill and by the Taste and Uncodexify skill variants. Every generation keeps per-model generation cost (Haiku 5.5 $0.80, Fable 5.1 $12.29), a compare view puts two generations side by side, a guess-the-model lab quizzes visitors, and a rankings page holds the author's taste-based ranking of models for frontend design.
contains: same landing-page prompt rendered by 12 models in 5 iterations
groups: with design skill, without design skill, with taste skill, with uncodexify skill
side-by-side compare view of two generations
author rankings of models for frontend design
